Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner's initial analysis incorrectly identified Albert I as the paternal grandfather of Albert IV. The lineage established in the conversation is Albert IV -> John II -> Albert II -> Albert I. This makes Albert II the paternal grandfather (father of John II) and Albert I the paternal great-grandfather (father of Albert II). The Planner failed to correctly calculate the generational distance, confusing the great-grandfather with the grandfather in the very first step of the analysis.
